python3 -c "
import struct

# Read the 7z file header
with open('/opt/miniconda3/envs/testbed/lib/python3.10/lib-dynload/fcntl.cpython.7z', 'rb') as f:
    header = f.read(32)
    print('Header bytes:', header.hex())
    # 7z header: 37 7a bc af 27 1c 00 04 XX
    # XX is the version number
    version = header[6]
    print('Version:', version)
